sop_final:
# Exact rational powers

Status: complete; durable transfer and cleanup in progress

## Intent and anchors

- Goal: calculate/eval exact rational results of positive rational bases raised to rational exponents, e.g. `8^(1/3)=2`, `16^(3/4)=8`, `(1/27)^(-1/3)=3`.
- Owners: `src/rational_expression/exact_rational.rs` for pure calculation and `well_defined_results/verify_obj/scalar.rs` for the closed Q+×Q domain. Existing calculate/eval consumers remain unchanged.
- Invariant: for reduced exponent p/q and reduced positive base a/b, accept only exact integer q-th roots of both a and b, then apply the existing checked integer-power operation.
- Baseline: fresh release rejects the three primary goals at Pow WD (exponent in Z); the exact calculator also required an integral exponent.
- Boundaries: preserve integer-power semantics; decline irrational results, invalid operands and checked overflow. No floating approximations.
- Non-goals: radical order/derived functions, binomial radical denominators, negative-base noninteger powers, new AST/state/search contracts.

## Action protocol

1. Build release, capture source/binary fingerprints and before cases (done: stable source, all three primary examples reject at WD).
2. Extend the existing rational leaf; exercise one persistent session, then promote accepted examples.
3. Run focused Rust and strict CLI gates, update owning Obj coverage/documentation and retain the journal/acceptance note.
- Tracer: `examples/proof_nodes/equal/by_builtin_rule/closed_rational_power_calculation.lit`.
- Impact: L2 exact numeric family; no dispatcher, state, evidence shape or syntax changes.
- Stop if protected AST/state changes or unsettled semantics become necessary.
- Skip full-kernel, whole-module and To-Lean gates: those contracts are unchanged.

## Completion evidence

- [x] Fresh release build and source/binary identity recorded; stable final snapshot ddd70747/b0360930.
- [x] 23 selected rational-power/elementary/closed-numeric/integer-power release tests pass.
- [x] 38 strict CLI gates pass: tracer, owning Pow, negatives, individual new cases, docs and independent exact eval values.
- [x] Before/after, pure calculation provenance, eval output/no stores and domain/overflow boundaries retained.
- [x] Pow inventory: 29 positives/12 rejection files; complete AST/fixture audit passes after concurrent manifest updates. Durable journal/acceptance transfer checked before deleting task drafts and this SOP.

## Contract deviations

- Additional old mixed-module run: 9 pass/3 fail on previously recorded route/output expectations; no test weakening or unrelated fix. Baseline/final CLI comparison retained.
- First CLI snapshot spanned two unrelated test updates; rebuild and replay yielded stable source/binary for all 38 checks. A temporary global inventory mismatch during concurrent set edits resolved; final global and scoped audits pass.
- First final build hit four independent witness diagnostic visibility errors in concurrently edited source; readonly follow-up observed the public-path repair already applied. Rebuild and retain the failed attempt; no witness code changed by this task.
- Baseline proves the earliest blocker is the missing Pow domain, before the integer-only calculator. Add a closed positive-rational/rational branch with checked Q+/Q certificates; irrational results may be WD but remain uncomputed.
- Current CLI implements `-strict -f/-e` and an ordinary REPL; obsolete skill command spellings `-runner/-compact/-before/try` do not apply. Use parsed JSON `success` plus process exit, and discarded sketch scopes for persistent probes.
